title: ProducerDeclarationDraft
description: Draft producer release declaration for station FC-2; placement in the SDK awaits the steward ruling.

claims.description: Published claim declarations, including superseded ids.

cures.description: Cumulative entries from this and every earlier release; at most one per claim and release. The latest entry by SemVer precedence declares each claim’s state; may be empty.

id.description: Full published claim id; ASCII grammar makes the 128-character limit exactly 128 bytes.

asserts.description: Sentence stating what the claim asserts.

contradictedBy.description: Sentence describing the observation that contradicts the claim.

validityHorizon.description: ISO 8601 duration before unanswered validity needs review.

supersedes.description: Declared claim ids this claim replaces.

clears.description: Alternative clearing conditions; any one holding is sufficient.

polarity.description: Classification of the declared command or problem.
polarity.$comment: Lifecycle polarity classifies the claim, unlike the SDK observation-polarity enum which describes support or strain, so that enum is not referenced.

severity.description: Producer concern expressed in the six standard logging names.
severity.$comment: The six standard names of the lifecycle design (its section on severity); elohim/epr/src/algedonic.rs has three levels and the Genesis adapter three other names, so neither list is referenced.

weight.description: Occurrence cost serialized by brit as u8; zero includes intentional refusals.

ceiling.description: Highest permitted graduation rung for a summary.
ceiling.$comment: Lifecycle graduation rungs differ from SDK reach visibility rings, so the reach enum is not referenced.

retireWhen.description: Quiet duration before retirement, or null for the retention-policy watch; always serialized.

cure.description: Available action text; omitted when absent, never serialized as null.

claim.description: Declared claim id whose state this entry records.

release.description: Producer version of the release that made this entry, ordered by SemVer precedence. Build metadata is not allowed: two versions that differ only in it have equal precedence, so they could not be ordered.

state.description: Producer-declared state of this claim in the entry’s release.
state.$comment: reopened is a reading a device reaches, not a state written by a producer.

cite.description: Non-empty citation supporting the cure or its withdrawal.

summary.description: Non-empty release-reviewed explanation of the cure or its withdrawal.
